title: The technician opens the attached file, unsupported types offer download
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  • A template whose fields carry attachments of various types (PDF, web image, HEIC, TIFF, Word, Excel).
  • Fill an inspection with "Work orders - View".
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the attached file is visible on the canvas on the field's row, and the technician sees it while filling and can open it.
2. Open a PDF and a web image and confirm they are readable in a full-page view in the same tab, with a close action and a download action, without downloading.
3. Open a HEIC/TIFF/Word/Excel file and confirm the viewer says it cannot render it and offers the download, rather than opening blank or silently downloading.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The technician sees the attached file while filling and can open it as a full-page view in the same tab, with a close action and a download action; a PDF and a web image are readable there without downloading.
  • A file the viewer cannot render (HEIC, TIFF, Word, Excel) says so in that view and offers the download, rather than opening blank or silently downloading.
  • The attached file is visible on the canvas on the field's row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9109 (S11 — Attach a reference file to a question); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S11; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R4: “The technician will see the attached file while filling and will be able to open it. It will open as a full-page view in the same tab, with a close action and a download action. A PDF and a web image are readable there without downloading”
  • S11-R9: “A file the viewer cannot render — HEIC, TIFF, Word, Excel — will say so in that view and offer the download, rather than opening blank or silently downloading. Converting those types on the server so they can be read in place is a separate ticket; until it lands the viewer is honest about the limit instead of pretending”
  • S11-R5: “The attached file will be visible on the canvas on the field's row”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
